title: About
overview_text: Mary Gold is a youth-focused non-governmental Organization committed to empowering young people through mentorship, leadership development, capacity building, and advocacy. We believe that every young person has potential, and with the right guidance, opportunities, and support, they can become transformational leaders in their communities and beyond.
objectives_subtitle: Guiding principles that drive our mission and define our approach
objectives_group_subtitle: Clear goals that guide our programs and initiatives
values_subtitle: The principles that define who we are and how we operate
mission_text: To inspire, guide, and support young people through mentorship, leadership development, and advocacy, empowering them to reach their full potential and create positive change in their communities.
vision_text: To build a generation of empowered, purpose-driven young leaders who are equipped to shape a better future for themselves and their society.
team_subtitle: Our board of trustees is made up of diverse individuals with relevant expertise and requisite field experience to drive the cause of the organisation.
cta_heading: Join Us in Making a Difference
cta_text: Whether you're interested in volunteering, partnering with us, or supporting our programs financially, there are many ways to get involved and help us empower the next generation.
